name: SYSmoAI — Content Pack Auto-Publisher
_about: Hourly cron sweeps the queue for posts due in the next 24h, pushes text-only channels into Buffer with provider-side scheduled_at so each row publishes at its own BDT slot, sends the newsletter via Resend only when its slot is within the next hour, and posts a Slack manual-publish alert (also gated to within 1h of the slot) for IG / TikTok which need media-asset upload. X threads are split on '\n---\n', the 'Tweet N/M' header is stripped, and each tweet is sent as a real Buffer thread (text=tweet1, thread[][text]=tweet2..N). Rows already pushed (postUrl set) are skipped on later sweeps. Every Buffer / Resend node has continueErrorOutput → Slack failure channel. Required env: SYSMOAI_API_BASE, SYSMOAI_AUTOMATION_TOKEN, SYSMOAI_ADMIN_BASE, BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN, BUFFER_PROFILE_LINKEDIN, BUFFER_PROFILE_X, RESEND_API_KEY, NEWSLETTER_FROM, NEWSLETTER_AUDIENCE_ID, SLACK_FALLBACK_CHANNEL.

nodes.name: Skip if already queued
nodes._about: Rows with postUrl set have already been pushed to Buffer or Slack-alerted — true branch (empty) continues, false dead-ends so we don't double-send.

nodes.name: Buffer schedule → X thread
nodes._about: Real X thread scheduling: parses the row's content into individual tweets (split on '---', strip 'Tweet N/M' headers), validates each ≤280 chars, then POSTs to Buffer with text=tweet1 + thread[][text]=tweet2..N. Buffer publishes the whole sequence at scheduled_at. Throws on any failure → Slack provider-failure branch.

nodes.name: Newsletter — due within 1h?
nodes._about: Resend has no native scheduling — only fire when within the current cron window (≈1h).

nodes.name: Visual — due within 1h?
nodes._about: IG / TikTok need a human to upload media. Only ping Slack when the row's BDT slot is within the next hour, so the operator gets the alert at the actual peak time — not 24h early.

nodes.name: Mark Buffer-queued
nodes._about: Stamps postUrl with the Buffer update id (using the original row id from Split items, NOT $json.id which is now Buffer's response). Skip-if-already-queued IF then ignores this row on the next sweep. Handles both Buffer HTTP responses and the X-thread Code-node payload shape.

nodes.name: Slack — provider failure
nodes._about: Receives error outputs from every Buffer / Resend / thread Code node (continueErrorOutput). Covers missing tokens / network failures / 4xx / thread-validation errors.
